correctness.rationale: Exact Wendel/Dirichlet conditioning and independent short-gap vector; exact shoelace/chord identities; verified beta and cubic Dirichlet moments; fifth-power Taylor remainder has expected \(O(n^{-4})\), and bivariate exponential CLT/delta method yields variance 360. All five coordinates follow jointly by Slutsky, with asymptotic independence from the independently sampled long-gap mark. Finite code checks corroborate rather than prove the limit.

value.rationale: Conditioning on a classical exponentially rare Wendel center-miss event radically changes random polygon geometry (limit half disk versus whole disk). The theorem splits a physically meaningful long-gap exponential deformation from an independent Gaussian discretization error, and characterizes a non-Gaussian second-order area-versus-perimeter discrepancy. These natural quantities are relevant to geometric sampling and conditional reconstruction, not arbitrary table recomputation.
